provider: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin

request_contract.parameter_rules: Only one exact manually initiated anonymous HTTPS GET https://gdi.berlin.de/services/wfs/alkis_gebaeude?request=GetCapabilities&service=WFS; verify original WFS 2.0.0 service identity, Berlin provider, licence/access constraints, and fixed layer alkis_gebaeude:gebaeude with EPSG:25833. No GetFeature, DescribeFeatureType, pagination, BBOX, parameters, arbitrary hosts/paths, redirects, feature attributes, cadastral coordinates, owners, credentials, bulk downloads or scheduled provider polling.

response_contract.format: WFS 2.0.0 GetCapabilities XML metadata only: exact ALKIS Berlin Gebaeude identity, OWS ServiceIdentification, OWS Fees/AccessConstraints, FeatureTypeList containing alkis_gebaeude:gebaeude and EPSG:25833. No feature geometry or attributes requested.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Official mutable cadastral building and building-part geometry; updated monthly. An individual ALKIS feature may represent a building or building part rather than one insured asset. Original EPSG:25833 feature identity, date/vintage, geometry type and provenance must survive ingestion. Do not infer building age, insured location, replacement value, TIV, construction type or hazard vulnerability. A separately produced 2022 LoD2 building-height layer derives from ALKIS footprints and height surfaces and is not geometrically independent of this WFS. Historical 2021 building stock cannot be inferred from a current 2026 feature alone.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Official WFS capabilities and government geodata catalogue allow public anonymous access to the building layer; no numerical quota was published. Permit exactly one metadata-only GET on an explicit manually dispatched reviewed action, no retry or automatic recurrence. A wider automated data acquisition, GetFeature or large-scale query requires an independent service and rights review.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Provider describes monthly ALKIS updates; catalogue metadata show 2026 publication/update dates. Bind every later source read to exact UTC retrieval time, service response SHA-256, feature schema/CRS, requested bbox and dataset vintage; never silently substitute current geometry for the 2021 stock or 2022 LoD2 baseline.

rights_and_policy.notes: Original provider WFS GetCapabilities (2026-11-12) self-declares Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0 and 'Es gelten keine Zugriffsbeschraenkungen'. Berlin official dataset metadata identifies anonymous download access and same licence. Berlin general cadastral-use terms distinguish protected owner/measurement records from other ALKIS data and those remain out of scope. Commercial automated access judgement is limited to one manually dispatched WFS capabilities metadata GET; there is no approved poll rate, commercial bulk extraction, feature-level personal data processing, redistribution of unreviewed attributes, CAT exposure or model admission.

expected_evidence: Exact single original HTTPS 200 GetCapabilities XML, no redirects or arbitrary parameters
At most 1 MiB; strict XML parsing with no DTD or entity expansion; OGC WFS 2.0.0 and Berlin ALKIS Gebaeude identity
Original provider official data licence DL-DE Zero 2.0 and access constraints no restrictions recorded as metadata only
Frozen alkis_gebaeude:gebaeude feature type and EPSG:25833 default CRS in original capabilities
Request SHA-256, original response SHA-256, response byte count, executable code SHA-256 and retrieval UTC
No provider payload persistence, GetFeature, owner or building data, geometry download or CAT model admission

notes: Exactly one reviewed metadata-only WFS capabilities probe was added, not a GetFeature approval. This remains a landscape non-admission. Berlin buildings/building parts do not constitute independent insured assets or TIV; past five-feature evidence is not upgraded, and owner information remains excluded.
